title: Returned Remittance Fee Clause, Payoff and Loan Satisfaction
content:
## Returned remittance fee — Payoff and Loan Satisfaction

On the payoff case of a Borrower Voluntary Payoff requested by the borrower of record on a loan whose maturity case is due and payable, in its extension period or referred to foreclosure, the returned remittance fee is part of the retention remittance.

The returned remittance fee is USD 35.00, the returned check fee, when any payoff funds return on the case was a cashier's check, and USD 25.00, the recalled wire fee, when the case carries a returned wire and no returned cashier's check; a case with neither carries nothing (0.00).

| Returned cashier's check on the case | Returned wire on the case | Returned remittance fee |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes or no | USD 35.00 |
| no | yes | USD 25.00 |
| no | no | nothing |

The fee is charged once, whatever the number of returns.
